test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Find the ANTONYM of the word ‘aggravate’ from the passage.
solution:
The correct answer is Option (1) i.e.** "Oblige".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Aggravate: (बिगाड़ना) **- To make worse or more severe

 
 
• **Example**: Skipping meals can aggravate stomach ulcer symptoms.
 
 
 
• **Oblige: (उपकार करना) **- To make someone legally or morally bound to do something
 
 
• **Example**: He's always willing to oblige friends.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is "**Oblige**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dedicate: (समर्पित करना) **- Devote (time, effort, or oneself) to a particular task or purpose
 
• **Tease: (छेड़खानी करना) **- Make fun of or attempt to provoke in a playful way
 
• **Irritate: (चिढ़ाना) **- Make (someone) annoyed, impatient, or angry

198:T732,

The correct answer is Option (3).</s
